annotations.title: Learn from link pages the person likes

description: Read public link-in-bio pages the person likes and say what they do: how many links and sections, what comes first, how links are named, socials, photo and look. handles are tried as linktr.ee/handle (Instagram and TikTok profiles can't be read); urls are the pages themselves, so ask for the address when a handle isn't found. Returns patterns as counts and kinds, what the pages share set against this page (findings), and new names for this page's links (apply with link_update). Never their link names, bio, photos, colors or branding. Each page read is saved to the style library (style_references_list) unless save is false; undo with activity_id takes those off again.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

save.description: Save each page read to the style library

urls.description: Link pages, e.g. linktr.ee/name or a site's links page

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
